1662.name: Sprite tweaker: clipping and death
1662.kind: bit flags + 6-bit index, byte table indexed by sprite slot (index X)
desc: First sprite property byte. Its low six bits select the sprite's hitbox (clipping) entry, used by Mario contact,
sprite-to-sprite contact and Yoshi's tongue. Loaded from a per-sprite-number table at spawn and rewritten by
sprites that change size (Rex squash sets 0, Pokey sets it from its segment count, Bob-omb explosion $11).
Values: bits 0-5 = clipping index. Bit 6 = use the shell frame when drawn as a killed sprite ($019B27).
Bit 5 is tested as 'smushed' by the Pokey/Wiggler code and bit 7 by the bounce-block hit code ($02946E).

166E.name: Sprite tweaker: interaction and palette
166E.kind: bit flags, byte table indexed by sprite slot (index X)
desc: Second sprite property byte, copied from Sprite166EVals[sprite number] when the sprite is spawned and zeroed
when the slot is cleared. Low nibble holds palette/graphics-page bits; the high bits are interaction switches.
Bits: Bit 7 = skip sprite-block interaction (checked at $01926A). Bit 6 = no water/lava splash.
Bit 5 = ignores cape and bounce-block hits. Bit 4 = ignores Mario's fireballs.
The shell/kicked code sets bits 4-5 ($30) so a kicked sprite cannot be killed by fireballs or the cape.

167A.name: Sprite tweaker: Mario interaction
167A.kind: bit flags, byte table indexed by sprite slot (index X)
desc: Third sprite property byte, loaded per sprite number at spawn. Controls how the sprite interacts with Mario,
attacks and the screen edge. Code changes bits at run time: Boo sets bit 7, bounced/pressed sprites clear it.
Bits: Bit 7 = do not use the default Mario interaction (sprite handles contact itself). Bit 6 = gives a power-up
when eaten by Yoshi. Bit 4 = can be kicked like a shell. Bit 2 = keep processing when off-screen.
Bit 1 = invincible to fireballs/cape/explosion kills.

1686.name: Sprite tweaker: sprite interaction
1686.kind: bit flags, byte table indexed by sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: Fourth sprite property byte, loaded from Sprite1686Vals[sprite number] at spawn and cleared when the slot is
reset. Mostly settings for how the sprite interacts with other sprites, objects and Yoshi's tongue.
Bits: Bit 3 = no sprite-to-sprite interaction (the interaction loop ORs the byte for both sprites).
Bit 2 = object (block) interaction setting, tested in the sprite map16 lookup. Bit 7 is cleared by Bowser's retreat
state. Other bits are tested by the tongue, stomp and level-end code; meaning not traced here.

1692.name: Sprite memory setting
desc: Which sprite-memory (OAM allotment) setting the level uses: the sprite header's low six bits, stored while the
level loads. Selects a row of tables that decide how many OAM tiles each sprite slot is given and which slots
the spawn routines may use. Read when sprites are drawn, when finding a free slot and when spawning from level
data; the line-guide rope/platform init also tests it for non-zero.
Values: 0 = default setting; other values select the alternative layouts.

1693.name: Map16 tile number under probe
1693.kind: byte (scratch result of a tile lookup)
desc: Low byte of the Map16 tile that the last block lookup landed on, as an acts-like tile number. Set by the
collision lookups for Mario, sprites, bounce/extended sprites, the cape and Yoshi's berry check, then read
straight away to decide the response (solid, slope, coin, pipe, P-switch swap, ...).
Only valid right after a lookup; not meaningful between lookups.

1694.name: Slope surface offset
desc: Height offset along the surface of a slope tile at the probe point, used by sprite and extended-sprite
block checks to place the sprite on the slope. Written by the sprite vertical check; cleared to 0 at the
start of those checks and by the extended-sprite tile collision, meaning 'no offset'.
Values: 0 = flat / no slope offset.

1695.name: Saved slot or loop counter
desc: General scratch byte that holds a sprite slot index or loop counter across a call that reuses X or Y.
Examples: sprite B's slot in the sprite-to-sprite loop, the candidate slot while spawning Baby Yoshi or a block
item, the probe counter (3..0) of the line-guide engine, Yoshi's tongue loop, extended-sprite slot for the Koopa Kid
and the hitting sprite for Pokey. Also stores last frame's liquid flags ($164A) in the sprite-block code.
No single meaning; each routine reloads it right after use.

1697.name: Consecutive stomp counter
desc: Counts enemies Mario has stomped (or bounced off) since last touching the ground. The count picks the score
(100, 200, 400, ... up to 1-UP) and is read when the stomp is rewarded, by Yoshi's stomp shake, Dry Bones and
the push-out routine. Incremented on each stomp (Wiggler too) and when Mario mounts Yoshi.
Reset to 0 in Mario's block/slope collision when he lands.
Values: 0 = no stomps in the current chain.

1698.name: Saved misc sprite slot
desc: Slot index of the minor extended sprite, bounce sprite or smoke sprite currently being processed. The per-frame
handlers store X here ($028B6E) and reload X from it after calling subroutines that clobber it (draw and
tile-check helpers). Read only to restore X or Y.

1699.name: Bounce sprite number table
1699.kind: byte table, one per bounce sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: Type of the bounce sprite in each slot (block hit from below, turn block spin, etc.). Written when a block is
hit, read by the bounce sprite loop and drawing code. Zeroed to free the slot when the block lands.
Values: 0 = slot free. 1-6 = bounce block routine, 7 = turn block routine.

169D.name: Bounce sprite init flag
169D.kind: flag byte table, one per bounce sprite slot (index X)
desc: Zeroed when a bounce sprite is created and incremented by its first frame, so the routine can run its one-time
set-up (play sound, check things) only once.
Values: 0 = not yet initialized; nonzero = initialized.

16A1.name: Bounce sprite Y position low
16A1.kind: byte table, one per bounce sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: Low byte of the bounce sprite's Y position. Set from the block's position when spawned, moved by its Y speed
each frame, and used to place the block when it turns back into a tile. Partner of $16A9 (Y high).
Also reused by the shooter smoke helpers to move extended/smoke sprites.

16A5.name: Bounce sprite X position low
16A5.kind: byte table, one per bounce sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: Low byte of the bounce sprite's X position, copied from the block when spawned. Read for drawing and when
the bounce sprite becomes a block tile again. Partner of $16AD (X high).

16A9.name: Bounce sprite Y position high
16A9.kind: byte table, one per bounce sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: High byte of the bounce sprite's Y position ([$16A1] is the low byte). Adjusted for borrow/carry when the
position moves and when the sprite is aligned to a tile row before drawing.

16AD.name: Bounce sprite X position high
16AD.kind: byte table, one per bounce sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: High byte of the bounce sprite's X position ([$16A5] is the low byte). Set when the block is hit, read by
the drawing routine and when the block is regenerated.

16B1.name: Bounce sprite Y speed
16B1.kind: signed byte table, one per bounce sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: Vertical speed of the bounce sprite. Set at spawn from BlockBounceSpeedY (up for a block hit from below,
down for a block hit from above) and changed each frame by gravity-like steps from DATA_029072 in the
turn block routine. Applied to the position by the speed helper at $02B526.

16B5.name: Bounce sprite X speed
16B5.kind: signed byte table, one per bounce sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: Horizontal speed of the bounce sprite, from BlockBounceSpeedX at spawn. Nonzero for blocks hit from the side
(+$40 / $C0). Applied by the bounce block routine each frame.

16C1.name: Bounce sprite resulting tile
16C1.kind: byte table, one per bounce sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: Map16 tile the bounce sprite turns back into when its timer runs out (the block's used/empty form, or a
turned-over block). Stored from $07 at spawn; read by the 'turn bounce sprite into its block' routine.
Also read by the 'Find bounce sprite slot' check.

16C5.name: Bounce sprite timer
16C5.kind: timer byte table, one per bounce sprite slot (index X)
desc: Frame countdown for the bounce sprite. Set to 8 frames at spawn and decremented by the loop; when it hits
zero the sprite stops and the block is regenerated.
Values: 0 = timer expired.

16C9.name: Bounce sprite direction and layer
16C9.kind: bit flags + index, byte table indexed by bounce sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: Packs which way the block was hit with a layer bit. Bits 0-1 index the speed/direction tables
(DATA_0290D6/DA, BlockBounceSpeedX/Y: hit from below, right, left, above). Bit 7 is tested to choose
the screen boundary set for drawing and tile placement, probably layer 1 versus layer 2.
Written at spawn ([$06] ORed with a rotated bit from [$08]); read while the sprite moves, is drawn and is regenerated.

16CD.name: Block-hit hitbox status
16CD.kind: byte table, one per block-hit hitbox slot (index Y)
desc: Which kind of block-hit hitbox occupies each slot: used to make Mario's bumped block, a Yoshi ground stomp
or the cape hit adjacent sprites. The value indexes the hitbox size/offset tables when the hitbox is tested.
Values: 0 = slot free. 1 = block hit by Mario. 2 = Yoshi stomp shake.

16D1.name: Block-hit hitbox X low
16D1.kind: byte table, one per block-hit hitbox slot (index Y)
desc: Low byte of the hitbox X position of the slot in [$16CD]. Set from the block position or, for a Yoshi stomp,
from Mario's X ($0094). Partner of $16D5 (X high). Read when testing sprites against the hitbox.

16D5.name: Block-hit hitbox X high
16D5.kind: byte table, one per block-hit hitbox slot (index Y)
desc: High byte of the hitbox X position ([$16D1] is the low byte). Written when a block hits; read by the
bounce block and cape hitbox test.

16D9.name: Block-hit hitbox Y low
16D9.kind: byte table, one per block-hit hitbox slot (index Y)
desc: Low byte of the hitbox Y position. For a Yoshi stomp it is Mario's Y ($0096) + $20 (his feet);
for a block hit it is the block's Y minus the scroll offset. Partner of $16DD (Y high).

16DD.name: Block-hit hitbox Y high
16DD.kind: byte table, one per block-hit hitbox slot (index Y)
desc: High byte of the hitbox Y position ([$16D9] is the low byte). The Yoshi stomp routine first writes
Mario's X high ($0095) here, which looks like a mistake for $16D5; it is overwritten afterwards.

16E1.name: Score sprite type
16E1.kind: byte table, one per score sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: Which number a score sprite shows (10, 20, 40, ... 1000, 1-UP etc.). Written by anything that awards points
(stomps, coins, block hits, smoke-puff contact), read by the score update to pick the amount to add and the
tiles to draw.
Values: 0 = slot free. $0D = 1-UP; other values select an amount in the score table.

16E7.name: Score sprite Y position low
16E7.kind: byte table, one per score sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: Low byte of the score sprite's Y position, spawned 8 pixels above the source sprite. The update routine
decrements it each frame so the number rises. Partner of $16F9 (Y high).

16ED.name: Score sprite X position low
16ED.kind: byte table, one per score sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: Low byte of the score sprite's X position, copied from the source sprite or coin when spawned.
Partner of $16F3 (X high). Read while the number is positioned on screen.

16F3.name: Score sprite X position high
16F3.kind: byte table, one per score sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: High byte of the score sprite's X position ([$16ED] is the low byte). The update routine computes the
16-bit difference to the screen edge from it to see whether the number is off-screen.

16F9.name: Score sprite Y position high
16F9.kind: byte table, one per score sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: High byte of the score sprite's Y position ([$16E7] is the low byte). Borrowed from (decremented) when the
low byte wraps while the number rises.

16FF.name: Score sprite timer and rise speed
16FF.kind: byte table, one per score sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: Set to $30 when a score sprite is created and counted down once per frame. It doubles as the lifetime and the
rise-speed control: when it reaches 0 the number has finished and the slot ($16E1) is freed.
Values: $30 = freshly spawned; 0 = finished.

1705.name: Score sprite layer index
1705.kind: byte table, one per score sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: Selects which scroll/layer position the number is drawn relative to. The score update multiplies it by 4 and
uses it as an index into the screen boundary words ($001A/$001C region), so 0 is layer 1 and the next
value is layer 2. Written when the score sprite is spawned (0 by block interaction, from the source
sprite's layer elsewhere); a comment in the source guesses it is a timer, but the code treats it as a layer index.

170B.name: Extended sprite number
170B.kind: byte table, one per extended sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: Type of the extended sprite in each slot: fireballs, smoke puffs, bubbles, hammers, bones, baseballs,
splashes, sparkles, Reznor fireballs, Wiggler flowers and so on. Written by whatever spawns one, read by the
extended sprite loop to dispatch to the matching routine and by the cape and fireball hit tests.
Values: 0 = slot free. 1 = smoke puff, 6 = bone, 7 = lava splash, 8 = Torpedo Ted arm, $0A = cloud game coin,
$0B = Piranha fireball, $0C = Volcano Lotus fire, $0E = Wiggler flower.

1715.name: Extended sprite Y position low
1715.kind: byte table, one per extended sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: Low byte of the extended sprite's Y position ([$1729] is the high byte). Set at spawn (e.g. Hopping flame,
Yoshi spit, Mario fireball), moved by Y speed ($173D) each frame, and temporarily saved/restored around
tile-collision tests.

171F.name: Extended sprite X position low
171F.kind: byte table, one per extended sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: Low byte of the extended sprite's X position ([$1733] is the high byte). Set at spawn, moved by X speed
($1747) each frame, restored after the hitbox and tile-collision checks.

1729.name: Extended sprite Y position high
1729.kind: byte table, one per extended sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: High byte of the extended sprite's Y position ([$1715] is the low byte). Updated with the carry/borrow
when the 16-bit position changes and saved/restored around tile checks.

1733.name: Extended sprite X position high
1733.kind: byte table, one per extended sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: High byte of the extended sprite's X position ([$171F] is the low byte). Updated with the carry when the
X speed is added, and saved/restored around tile checks.

173D.name: Extended sprite Y speed
173D.kind: signed byte table, one per extended sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: Vertical speed of each extended sprite, in 1/16 pixel per frame (positive = down). Set at spawn (Mario
fireball $30 down, thrown hammer / flower / game coin $D0 up) and changed by gravity: the hammer adds 2 per
frame up to $40, fireballs bounce using a table. Read by the movement code.

1747.name: Extended sprite X speed
1747.kind: signed byte table, one per extended sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: Horizontal speed of each extended sprite, in 1/16 pixel per frame (positive = right). Set at spawn from
a direction or table. The smoke trail halves it with an arithmetic shift; the baseball/bone code flips it.
The unused following-sprite routine misuses it as the index of the sprite to follow.

175B.name: Fireball hit counter
175B.kind: counter byte table, one per extended sprite slot (index X)
desc: Counts how many times a Mario fireball has hit a wall. Incremented on the hit; the fireball dissipates when
it reaches its limit, and the counter is reset to 0 when the fireball bounces off the floor ($02A010).

1765.name: Extended sprite counter
1765.kind: counter byte table, one per extended sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: Per-type counter. Animation frame counter for Mario's fireball, the small flame remnant, the baseball/bone
and the hammer/spinner (incremented every frame); bounce counter for Wiggler flowers and cloud-game coins;
phase counter for water bubbles. Cleared or preset to 1 by the spawners.

176F.name: Extended sprite timer
176F.kind: timer byte table, one per extended sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: General-purpose countdown or lifetime for each extended sprite; meaning per type. Examples: smoke puff $0F
frames, Yoshi spit fireball $A0, Hopping flame fire $FF, bubble timer/phase 0 at spawn.
The type's routine counts it down and deletes the sprite ($170B = 0) or changes frames when it expires.
Values: 0 = timer expired.

1779.name: Extended sprite layer flag
1779.kind: flag byte table, one per extended sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: Whether the extended sprite is behind scenery. Mario's fireball copies Mario's behind-scenery flag at spawn;
Yoshi's spit sets 0. Collision checks XOR it with the target's flag and skip the contact when they are on
different layers (fireball vs. sprite, smoke puff vs. Mario, Reznor fireball).
Values: 0 = in front; nonzero = behind scenery.

1783.name: Shooter type table
1783.kind: byte table, one per shooter slot (index X, 8 slots)
desc: Type of each active shooter (Bullet Bill shooter, Torpedo Ted launcher, ...), stored by LoadShooter as the
level data's shooter sprite number minus $C8 and, per the shooter loop, read as type + 1. The shooter loop
runs each non-empty slot every frame. LoadShooter looks for a free slot by scanning for a zero entry.
Values: 0 = slot free.
